scope: The single causal entry-legality law for FT2-08 labels/census, FT2-10 composition and comparators, FT2-11 evidence, and the future historical/live guard implementation.

numeric_primitives.rounding: Convert the executable option quote to integer quote cents before multiplication; fee reserves and every ledger mutation are integer cents; no floating comparison is legal.

decision_time_intent.clock: At completed decision minute t, use information with event/source timestamps no later than the frozen FT2-08 cutoffs through t.
decision_time_intent.screen_price: A_t, the selected exact contract's last known executable ask in the completed option state stamped t.
future_information_forbidden: existence or freshness of the t+1 quote
future bid, path, label, target_valid, or label presence
per_contract_base_requirements: fresh finite positive bid and ask in the same completed-minute state
ask greater than or equal to bid
affordability from the policy's causal available-cash ledger
complete ladder, warmup, context-freshness, flat, no pending intent, no daily stop, and no prior soft close
decision_time_intent.buy_intent_legal: Every base requirement, D48 intent mask, and D49 intent mask is true.
decision_time_intent.composer_and_comparator_contract: The candidate composer, P5, and every live-style control may see only this decision-time intent mask. They know nothing about t+1 when choosing WAIT or one exact contract.
decision_time_intent.commit: A legal BUY selected at t reserves the one-position slot through the t+1 fill-time resolution.

soft_close.evaluation_time: Before action selection at every flat decision t, independently for each active fee path and policy ledger.
soft_close.otherwise_eligible_floor_candidate: A contract satisfying the decision-time base requirements other than prior soft-close, with A_t_quote_cents>=100, D48 intent true, and D49 intent true.
soft_close.trigger: No otherwise_eligible_floor_candidate exists in the current exact 42-contract ladder.
soft_close.threshold_role: The arithmetic lower bound for any floor candidate is computed from the active path: 10300 cents on fee_3 and 10400 cents on fee_4. The threshold is not a shared literal and does not replace the ladder-dependent existence predicate.
soft_close.effect: Permanently set soft_close_active=true for that policy, fee path, and session; all later new-entry intents are WAIT. Existing-position HOLD, EXIT, and forced-flat laws remain active.
soft_close.state_reset: Only the next session can reset soft_close_active.

fill_time_recheck.clock: At completed minute t+1 after a committed BUY intent, inspect only the committed exact contract.
fill_time_recheck.price: A_(t+1), the actual fresh executable ask for that identity at exactly t+1.
all_required: fresh finite positive A_(t+1) for the committed exact identity
fill_cost_cents<=causal available cash after prior ledger events and reservations
fill_time_recheck.pass: Open exactly one contract at A_(t+1); book the fee reserve once; occupancy begins at t+1.
fill_time_recheck.failure: Reject the committed fill fail-safe. No position opens, no premium or fee is charged, realized PnL is unchanged, and no alternative contract may be substituted at t+1.
fill_time_recheck.next_action_time_after_failure: The policy is flat after the t+1 resolution and may next decide no earlier than t+2 if all causal entry gates pass.

label_oracle_census_semantics.successful_fill_label: A realized-entry path label exists only after the selected intent passes the t+1 recheck and fills.
label_oracle_census_semantics.rejected_intent_label: A rejected intent has no position/path label, no fee, and zero realized policy PnL; it remains an explicit failed-fill event in serial population and census accounting.
label_oracle_census_semantics.live_style_policy_rule: P5, matched random, candidate, and every other live-style policy select from intent_eligible_at_t only, then recheck only the selected contract at t+1.
label_oracle_census_semantics.hindsight_oracle_rule: An explicitly labeled oracle ceiling may use future outcomes to rank opportunities, but it must report intent opportunity counts and fill-recheck rejection counts separately and may not rename a t+1 outcome as a decision-time legality mask.
label_oracle_census_semantics.denominator_rule: WAIT, committed intents, rejected fills, pending resolution, occupied minutes, and zero-trade sessions remain in their governed denominators.

historical_live_guard_equivalence.required: Historical replay, the historical-style source plane, the IBKR source plane, and the live order guard implement the same integer arithmetic, ordering, fee-path parameters, state inputs, intent mask, selected-contract-only recheck, rejection event, and fail-closed behavior.
historical_live_guard_equivalence.mismatch: invalid_evidence and WAIT/no fill; never choose the more permissive result.

required_boundary_fixtures: A_t passes D48 but A_(t+1) is one cent over D48
A_t passes D49 but A_(t+1) is one cent over D49
A_t is exactly $1.00 and A_(t+1) is $0.99
fee_3 floor candidate costs exactly 10300 cents
fee_4 floor candidate costs exactly 10400 cents
same ladder soft-closes under fee_4 but remains open under fee_3
no otherwise-eligible >=$1 ladder contract although remaining budget exceeds 10400 cents
rejected fill books no position, premium, fee, or PnL
failed fill may retry at t+2 but not at t+1
